role_desc.owner: Full control of the clinic, including backups and deleting the clinic.
role_desc.clinic_manager: Runs the clinic day to day: everything except deleting the clinic and restoring data.
role_desc.doctor: Their own schedule, patients' records, clinical notes and prescriptions.
role_desc.nurse: Waiting room, check-in and vital signs; reads clinical records.
role_desc.receptionist: Bookings, calendar, check-in and front-desk payments.
role_desc.accountant: Invoices, payments, expenses, doctor payroll and reports.
